# PEXEK OS — Enterprise Voice AI Infrastructure & Managed Deployment Partner

> PEXEK is an enterprise AI voice infrastructure company that designs, builds, and deploys autonomous AI voice agents for service businesses. PEXEK voice agents handle inbound call answering 24/7, qualify leads in under 60 seconds, schedule appointments into live calendars, and sync data bi-directionally with CRMs at sub-450ms speech-to-speech latency.

## Primary Entities & Concepts
- **Organization**: PEXEK (Legal Name: PEXEK AI Voice Infrastructure Systems)
- **Founder & Principal Architect**: Salah Eddine El Qaous
- **Category**: Enterprise Voice AI Infrastructure, Managed AI Receptionist, Conversational AI Telephony
- **Target Industries**: Dental Practices, Healthcare & Clinics, Legal Law Firms, Real Estate Brokerages, Home Services (HVAC/Plumbing/Roofing), E-commerce.
- **Key Products & Services**:
  - Voice AI Agents: Autonomous inbound and outbound call agents with natural vocal synthesis.
  - 24/7 AI Receptionist: Multi-line automated call answering and caller triage.
  - AI Lead Qualification: Real-time speed-to-lead scoring and intent extraction.
  - AI Appointment Booking: Direct calendar integration (Google Calendar, Outlook, EHRs).
  - CRM Workflow Automation: Live webhook dispatch to HubSpot, Salesforce, Dentrix, Zapier.
  - Managed Deployment Services: 100% done-for-you voice engineering and continuous prompt tuning.

## Core Performance Benchmarks
- **End-to-End Latency**: < 450 ms speech-to-speech response window.
- **Answer Rate**: 100% first-ring inbound call capture.
- **Security & Compliance**: SOC 2 Type II compliant standards, HIPAA-aligned data isolation, TLS 1.3 transit encryption, AES-256 resting encryption.

## System Architecture Summary
PEXEK operates an end-to-end voice AI pipeline comprising low-latency speech recognition (STT), deterministic dialogue & LLM orchestrators, neural text-to-speech (TTS), and real-time SIP/PSTN telephony gateways. Post-call logic triggers custom REST webhooks, JSON payload logging, and CRM record creation automatically.
